channel.title: Shekhar Luitel — Engineering Blog & Publications
channel.description: Technical publications on Atlassian community events, AI-driven DevOps, Linux workstation craft, and high-concurrency backend architecture by Shekhar Luitel.

item.title: Why I Use This Command: Supercharge Your Daily Standups with a Single Git Alias
item.description: How a single custom Git alias fetches a clean bullet list of yesterday's commits across all branches, saving hours during morning standups.

item.title: My Experience Learning Omarchy & Arch Linux: A Productive Developer Setup
item.description: A realistic look into adopting Arch Linux and Omarchy as a daily backend engineer, solving legacy PHP compilation via Docker, and maximizing terminal efficiency.

item.title: From Intern to Full Stack Developer: 3 Years of Building High-Concurrency Backend Systems at Veda App
item.description: An honest retrospective on starting as an engineering intern in 2023 while finishing my BCA, optimizing heavy MySQL queries, and shipping REST APIs supporting 50k+ active users.

item.title: From Ideas to Delivery: Building AI-First Product Organizations with Hermes Agents
item.description: Key takeaways from Om Prakash Sharma's session at ACE Lalitpur on architecting AI-First product organizations, multi-agent systems, and deploying Hermes Agents with Jira and Slack.

item.title: Inside Atlassian Community Kathmandu: The Evolution of Bitbucket into an AI-Native Platform
item.description: Reflections and event highlights from the Atlassian Community gathering at The Soaltee Kathmandu with Saroj Poddar. Exploring Bitbucket's transformation into an AI-native workspace with Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo Dev.
